Icons

One interface, three icon sets

Lucide for UI glyphs, Reicon for outline and filled weights, and Reicon Brands for logos in their official colors.

Lucide — UI glyphs

Reicon — outline + filled

Reicon Brands — official colors

Motion

Icons that morph, not swap

Morphicons animates the transition between any two icons — the shape flows from one shape to the next instead of cutting.

Tap any icon to morph it. Honors reduced-motion.
